Counter-terror drill held at Jammu's Raghunath temple

Security forces, including SOG Jammu and NSG, conducted a joint mock drill at the Raghunath temple in Jammu. The exercise aimed to enhance counter-terror preparedness, particularly ahead of anticipated journeys or events. This drill underscores ongoing efforts to bolster security in sensitive locations.
